counts.note: Headline counts use curated, source-reviewed records only. Metadata-only bibliography records and discovered candidates await relevance review and are reported separately; these populations overlap and must not be added together.

endpoints.name: resources
endpoints.description: Curated resources other than papers: models, datasets, benchmarks, agents, frameworks, infrastructure, tools, products, publishers and learning resources.

endpoints.name: papers
endpoints.description: Curated research papers and surveys, with authors, recorded publication dates, arXiv versions and citation files.

endpoints.name: categories
endpoints.description: Resource kinds and research topics with curated counts and links to their pages, Markdown and data.

endpoints.name: changes
endpoints.description: Catalog events in the 30 days before the snapshot: editorial reviews, new bibliography records and scope exclusions.

endpoints.name: candidates
endpoints.description: UNREVIEWED rows, clearly flagged: bibliography records awaiting relevance review and discovered identifiers awaiting any review. Not part of the curated catalog.
